rank1-prefill-log.description: Rank 1 logs each prefill's token count, next token and logits FNV on stderr (exactness evidence).

dist-latency-trace.description: Per-thread CLOCK_MONOTONIC marks of the USB4 exchange, buffered in memory and written as CSV at thread exit (nothing is written if the process is killed with SIGKILL).

dspark_max_inflight.effect: 0 drafts at every load (DSpark always on); 4 runs plain steps while more than 4 requests are in flight

qualification.evidence: docs/ds41-production-defaults.md, Code defaults: serve --dspark-max-inflight (4 keeps C1..C4 +19..+76 % without the C8 TTFT cost); requalified at 9211b07e (70ec42b9..9211b07e changes only README.md, README.es.md, REPO_DESCRIPTION.txt, docs/performance.md)

dspark_ranks.effect: 1 keeps the drafter on rank 0 only

qualification.evidence: docs/ds41-production-defaults.md, Code defaults: serve --dspark-ranks (2, off = 1); requalified at 9211b07e (70ec42b9..9211b07e changes only README.md, README.es.md, REPO_DESCRIPTION.txt, docs/performance.md)

serve_sched.effect: off: no interleaved prefill under load (8K prompt stalls decode ~13 s instead of <= 1 s; its own TTFT about halves)
